description: Ministry of Sports and Youth Affairs - Sports Law No. 25 of 1973 - Appoint the Committee Consisting of members to investigate financial Control
reasoning: This gazette establishes a special inquiry committee to investigate the Football Federation of Sri Lanka. While it involves government authority (the Minister of Sports), the primary focus is on appointing committee members (including a retired High Court Judge, former ministry secretary, retired police officer, and retired naval officer) to conduct an investigation into financial control, administration, and sports promotion matters. This falls under judicial/law enforcement gazettes as it involves investigative powers, legal authority under the Sports Law, and the committee has powers to obtain information and facilities for executing its functions, which aligns with Type 9 (Judicial/Law Enforcement Gazettes) for investigative committees and legal proceedings.
